codeFormat: Wowhead-style string of three "-"-separated segments, one per tree in `trees` order. Each segment has one decimal digit per talent (its rank, 0..maxRank), in `order` = sorted by tier, then col (both 0-based). Trailing zeros in a segment are trimmed; empty segments are kept, so a full code always has two "-" (e.g. "30305213132515201-05050103-"). The same codes as the foreverchanges.pro calculator's ?b=<code>; every code the repo stores decodes to the same ranks by talent name.
